title: Juz' 'Amma in six blocks: the revision rota: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Juz' 'Amma in six blocks rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 9. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Linking surahs
points: Know the order, not just the surahs
Last ayah of one, first ayah of the next

keywords.def: older memorised portion on a rota

questions.a: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ / Bismillah / وَٱلضُّحَىٰ; وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ / Bismillah / أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ.

questions.q: How many blocks in the rota?
Breakout pairs: recite today's block (block 4: 91 to 97) to a partner who marks the rubric. Today's rota group recites to the teacher.
questions.a: Partner rubric and one target; the teacher records rota scores.

questions.q: Extend: write your weekly block plan in the portal log.
Stretch: recite the first ayah of every surah in block 5 in order.

questions.a: A) Al-Fil. 105 Al-Fil follows 104 Al-Humazah; 103 Al-'Asr comes before.

questions.q: Think again: 37 surahs and only 10 to 15 minutes a day. How would you divide them so none is forgotten?
questions.a: Six blocks, one a day, so the whole juz' is revised each week.
